parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_ShowContainer.swift:19`) and `TrackContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_TrackContainer.swift:19`) share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of `item`: `Show` vs `Track`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: the varying `item` slot maps cleanly to an `associatedtype Item`, collapsing both protocols into a single generic `ContainerProtocol<Item>`. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies. Introducing the PAT eliminates the structural duplication while preserving full type safety for each concrete container.
